name: Lowell Weicker
summary:
Lowell Palmer Weicker Jr. (; May 16, 1931 – June 28, 2023) was an American politician who served as a member of the United States House of Representatives representing Connecticut's 4th congressional district from 1969 to 1971, a member of the United States Senate from 1971 to 1989, and the 85th governor of Connecticut from 1991 to 1995.
Weicker unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination for president in 1980.
